description: GET /api/tests/summary's figures read in statements shared by the figures over the same rows. before = the SQL the builders generated before the change (commit a4ec85c0d): one statement per figure, each a WHERE over the list's combined_health rows, six for a summary. after = the working tree's: one statement for the figures over each selection of combined rows, each figure an aggregate over the rows its own filters keep, and one for each figure that searches an array, with its other filters as the WHERE. Each sample is one version's statements sent together, as the endpoint sends them: wall_ms is the client's clock over them, network included, and statistics are each statement's own. The figures of the two versions are compared in every pair. Recorded again on 2026-11-25, after three changes of 2026-11-24: the list's default window became 3 hours (a request naming no window binds 3h); the first view, Unhealthy (Failing until then), began counting the flaky rows with the failing (its status binds two values); and the first view was given the default window as its own, so in another window its figure is read alone over main in 3 hours and after has four statements, three in the default window. before is the builders of commit a4ec85c0d run over the views as they are now, so both versions read the same rows for every figure; twelve_hours is the request that was the default until then.

fixture.note: Health is rebuilt every 15 minutes or so and replaces every row, so each pair's two reads run within one refresh or the pair is repeated. The generation is the refresh the statements are asked for at: it is bound and selected back as a constant, chooses no rows, and with use_query_cache = 0 keys nothing. unknown_repository is empty on purpose: over no rows the counts and the total are 0 and nothing is slowest.

WITH combined_health AS (
    SELECT
        tests_id, environments_id, env_vars_id,
        arraySort(arrayDistinct(workflow_paths)) AS workflow_paths_combined,
        toUInt64(runs) AS runs_combined,
        toUInt64(passed_runs) AS passed_runs_combined,
        toUInt64(failed_runs) AS failed_runs_combined,
        toUInt64(flaky_runs) AS flaky_runs_combined,
        toUInt64(skipped_runs) AS skipped_runs_combined,
        toUInt64(attempts) AS attempts_combined,
        if(
            passed_runs_combined > 0,
            toUInt32(intDiv(
                toUInt64(mean_passed_duration_milliseconds * passed_runs)
                    + intDiv(passed_runs_combined, 2),
                greatest(passed_runs_combined, 1)
            )),
            NULL
        ) AS mean_passed_duration_milliseconds_combined,
        toUInt64(total_duration_milliseconds) AS total_duration_milliseconds_combined,
        if(
            attempts_combined > 0,
            toUInt32(intDiv(
                total_duration_milliseconds_combined + intDiv(attempts_combined, 2),
                greatest(attempts_combined, 1)
            )),
            NULL
        ) AS mean_duration_milliseconds_combined,
        last_run_at AS last_run_at_combined,
        last_failed_at AS last_failed_at_combined,
        passed_runs_combined / nullIf(runs_combined, 0) AS pass_rate,
        failed_runs_combined / nullIf(runs_combined, 0) AS failure_rate,
        flaky_runs_combined / nullIf(runs_combined, 0) AS flaky_rate,
        skipped_runs_combined / nullIf(runs_combined + skipped_runs_combined, 0) AS skip_rate,
